scripts.build:client: bun run --cwd client build && bun scripts/gen-client-assets.ts
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p server && tsc -p client && tsc -p e2e
scripts.compile:linux-x64: bun scripts/fetch-cloudflared.ts linux-x64 && bun build --compile --target=bun-linux-x64 server/src/main.compiled.linux-x64.ts --outfile dist/tapalog-messenger-linux-x64
scripts.compile:linux-arm64: bun scripts/fetch-cloudflared.ts linux-arm64 && bun build --compile --target=bun-linux-arm64 server/src/main.compiled.linux-arm64.ts --outfile dist/tapalog-messenger-linux-arm64
scripts.compile:macos-arm64: bun scripts/fetch-cloudflared.ts macos-arm64 && bun build --compile --target=bun-darwin-arm64 server/src/main.compiled.macos-arm64.ts --outfile dist/tapalog-messenger-macos-arm64
scripts.compile:macos-x64: bun scripts/fetch-cloudflared.ts macos-x64 && bun build --compile --target=bun-darwin-x64 server/src/main.compiled.macos-x64.ts --outfile dist/tapalog-messenger-macos-x64
scripts.compile:windows-x64: bun scripts/fetch-cloudflared.ts windows-x64 && bun build --compile --target=bun-windows-x64 --windows-hide-console server/src/main.compiled.windows-x64.ts --outfile dist/tapalog-messenger-windows-x64.exe
